title: Momcozy Breastmilk Storage Bags, 200PCS Value Pack, Temp-Sensing Discoloration Milk Storing Bags for Breastfeeding, Presterilized, Hygienically Doubled-Sealing, for Freezing, 6 Ounce
bullets: TEMP-Sensing Discoloration: Help parents to keep track of milk temp at any time. Purple is Cold (＜36℃/96.8℉), blue is Optimum Feeding Temperature (36-40℃/96.8-104℉), and white is Hot (＞40℃/104℉).

Double Strong Sealing: Designed with double sealed side seams & double zipper to protect and freeze breastmilk. When sealing, press your fingertips and make a sound. Presterilized & BPA/BPS free thickened milk bag, safely build your milk bank.

Zero Contamination: Milk import/export separation design ensures that there is no contamination. Simply open the sealing strip when pouring milk, and cut along a cutting line when you need to breastfeeding. It's that easy!

Space-saving Design: Breast milk storage bags can be freezed super flat or upright. This unique feature also allows defrost or freeze milk quickly. Friendly Tips: Capacity is not exceed 6OZ. After milk is poured into the bag, it is necessary to release the air. After thawing, heat it to 40°C (104°F).
More Customers Options: Momcozy 200-Pack Breast Milk Storage Bags are the perfect pack size to support new parents' expressing and storing in their first few months!
